description:
VAGA AFIRMATIVA PARA MULHERES - SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST (31939)

The LA AI & Data Center of Excellence seeks a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our team. This role focuses on developing and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, emphasizing automation, software engineering best practices, and production-ready code. This role requires proficiency in Python programming and experience with various machine learning, deep learning, generative and agentic AI.

The successful candidate will work on projects across diverse business units, directly impacting critical decision-making and driving innovation.

You will lead the development of intelligent systems with a strong emphasis on software and AI engineering best practices, automation, and continuous delivery.

Experience and knowledge (Mandatory):

Strong experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering roles, demonstrating a history of delivering impactful AI solutions.

Expert-level Pythonprogramming, including Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and experience with RESTful API development. Experience with Flask/FastAPI for API development is a plus.

Strong software engineering foundation:Version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, Clean Code principles, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

Strong understanding of programming logic and object-oriented programming (OOP) principles to design modular, reusable, and maintainable code structures.

Proven experience inend-to-end ML (Machine Learning) lifecycle: data preparation, model training, tuning, inference, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

Data handling expertise:Extraction, cleaning, transformation, and loading (ETL) from various sources (relational and non-relational databases, cloud storage, APIs). Experience with SQL, NoSQL and vector databases.

Machine Learning & Deep Learning:Supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, time series, and NLP (Natural Language Processing).

Natural Language Processing (NLP): Experience with text preprocessing, pre-trained models (BERT, Roberta), fine-tuning, and NLP libraries (scikit-learn, spaCy, NLTK, Gensim).

Experience withGenerative AI(e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines).

Experience withcloud platforms: Azure (preferred), GCP or AWS, including their respective AI/ML services (e.g., Azure AI services).

Strong understanding of model evaluation, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning.

Experience and knowledge (Desirable):

Hands-on experience withmulti-agent systems and autonomous AI agents (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LangFlow), including the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Familiarity withdata engineering: experience with data warehousing, and big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks).

Experience withMLOpstools and practices: MLFlow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.

Experience working with knowledge graphs and graph-based data representations, including tools like Neo4j, RDF, SPARQL, Stardog or graph neural networks for reasoning and relationship modeling.

Domain knowledge (e.g.: experience in industry, laws, HR, marketing, etc.).

Ability to assess the business impact and profitability of AI models, including cost-benefit analysis, ROI estimation, and value tracking post-deployment.

Ph.D. in a relevant field.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or Physics.

Personality and working method: team player, problem-solving, analytical thinking, pro-active, self-taught, and resilient.

Strong communication & collaboration:ability to translate technical insights into accessible information for diverse audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in agile, cross-functional teams.

Continuous learning:Passion for staying current with AI advancements

Languages: Portuguese (Brazilian) and fluent in English. German is a plus.

description:
Overview

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care. Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

description:
Role and Responsibilities
  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests

    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS
Required Experience
  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)
Other Highly Desired Skills
  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Vaga 100% remota Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Na Sensedia, acreditamos que conexões movem o mundo digital. Nosso ferramenta de iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) combina o poder do Apache Camel com uma interface low-code que acelera o desenvolvimento de integrações modernas, seguras e escaláveis. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora Pleno, com sólidos conhecimentos em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento Java, para atuar na migração de pipelines da entre plataformas.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?
  • Construir e evoluir integrações usando a plataforma Sensedia Integrations (baseada em Apache Camel).
  • Migrar pipelines entre diferentes plataformas low code, garantindo desempenho, segurança e rastreabilidade.
  • Criar e consumir APIs REST e SOAP, aplicando boas práticas e padrões de integração enterprise (EIPs).
  • Implementar integrações assíncronas via mensageria (eventos, filas, tópicos).
  • Trabalhar com autenticação e autorização (OAuth 2.0, JWT).
  • Realizar transformações de dados em formatos JSON e XML (JOLT, JSONata, XSLT).
  • Garantir tratamento de erros, logging estruturado, circuit breaker e resiliência em fluxos de integração.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em fluxos técnicos claros e reutilizáveis.
  • Colaborar em revisões de código e boas práticas, contribuindo para a evolução da base Java da empresa.
  • Desenvolvimento de MS em Java.
Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?
  • Experiência prática em integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, middlewares, iPaaS ou ESBs).
  • Experiência em Java com foco em boas práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a objetos.
  • Conhecimento em Spring Boot, JUnit/Mockito e controle de dependências (Maven/Gradle).
  • Conhecimentos em MongoDB e bancos relacionais.
  • Experiência com integrações síncronas (REST/SOAP) e assíncronas (mensageria/eventos).
  • Entendimento de OAuth 2.0, JWT e segurança de APIs.
  • Familiaridade com observabilidade (logs, traces, métricas).
  • Conhecimento de padrões de integração enterprise (EIPs) e design patterns.
  • Capacidade de compreender fluxos complexos e propor soluções eficientes.
  • Familiaridade com transformação de dados (JOLT, JSONata, XSLT) e especificações OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com Apache Camel.
  • Experiência com Git.
  • Experiência com Docker e Docker Compose.
Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?
  • Vivência com plataformas iPaaS low-code/no-code (Digibee, Mulesoft, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em criptografia simétrica e assimétrica.
  • Experiência com CI/CDe ambientes em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou OCI)
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de microsserviços e boas práticas RESTful
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações cloud native.
  • Conhecimento nos recursos AWS: IAM, S3, EC2, Lambda, SQS, SNS, ECS, EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, Event Bridge.
  • Conhecimento em API Gateway.
Aqui você vai encontrar:
  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)

title: Gerente de Dados, Inteligência e Gestão do Conhecimento (Setor Social)
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

A Fundação FEAC é uma organização da sociedade civil, com sede em Campinas/SP, que há mais de seis décadas atua na promoção da equidade e do desenvolvimento social sustentável.

O Gerente de Dados, Inteligência e Gestão do Conhecimento será responsável por liderar e executar a estratégia de dados, inteligência e gestão do conhecimento da organização. O profissional deverá assegurar que a coleta, o armazenamento, a análise, a sistematização e a disseminação das informações e aprendizados estejam alinhadas à missão social. Sua atuação terá foco tanto no monitoramento contínuo e avaliação de impacto dos projetos sociais, quanto na transformação desse acervo em conhecimento estratégico, que fortaleça a tomada de decisão da própria instituição, de seus parceiros e do ecossistema do terceiro setor.

Além de gerar dados e evidências sobre o impacto das atividades internas, deverá promover e compartilhar conhecimento com públicos internos e externos, por meio de repositórios digitais, publicações, seminários, comunidades de prática e articulações institucionais. O objetivo é consolidar a organização como referência em produção e difusão de inteligência aplicada ao impacto social.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E REQUISITOS

Estratégia e Governança de Dados

  • Definir e implementar a política de dados da organização, incluindo governança, segurança, privacidade (em conformidade com a LGPD) e qualidade.
  • Promover uma cultura orientada a dados, estimulando o uso estratégico de informações para aprimorar a atuação social.
  • Garantir que os processos de coleta, tratamento e análise estejam integrados ao ciclo de decisão institucional.

Gestão Estratégica do Observatório

  • Definir a agenda de pesquisa e os temas prioritários de análise de dados, alinhados à missão e às necessidades do ecossistema social.
  • Desenvolver a visão estratégica do observatório como hub de conhecimento, advocacy e capacitação para o terceiro setor.
  • Garantir a transparência, a acessibilidade e a credibilidade das análises e publicações.

Monitoramento e Avaliação (MA) de Projetos

  • Estruturar e gerenciar metodologias de monitoramento e avaliação, incluindo indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas de impacto.
  • Supervisionar processos de coleta de dados durante a execução dos projetos (avaliação de processo).
  • Realizar análises de impacto, avaliando alcance de objetivos e mudanças sociais geradas.
  • Monitorar perfil, necessidades e nível de satisfação dos beneficiários, assegurando aderência ao público-alvo.

Análise de Dados e Relatórios de Impacto

  • Aplicar técnicas estatísticas e de modelagem para identificar padrões, correlações e tendências.
  • Desenvolver e manter bancos de dados estruturados e integrados.
  • Avaliar e implementar novas ferramentas e tecnologias para análise de dados.
  • Produzir relatórios de impacto social claros e orientados a diferentes stakeholders (poder público, conselho, parceiros, comunidade).
  • Desenvolver dashboards e visualizações acessíveis para apoiar decisões estratégicas.

Gestão do Conhecimento

  • Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de Gestão do Conhecimento Organizacional.
  • Estruturar repositórios digitais e bibliotecas de conhecimento, garantindo atualização e usabilidade.
  • Promover comunidades de prática e redes colaborativas, estimulando a troca de experiências.
  • Assegurar que lições aprendidas e boas práticas sejam capturadas, organizadas e disseminadas internamente e externamente.
  • Integrar gestão do conhecimento às ferramentas digitais e de colaboração (plataformas, intranets, IA).
  • Monitorar indicadores de adoção e uso do conhecimento, mensurando valor e impacto.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de inovação e aprendizagem contínua.

Gestão de Parcerias e Relacionamento

  • Estabelecer parcerias estratégicas com OSCs, universidades, órgãos governamentais e think tanks.
  • Representar a organização em fóruns, eventos e seminários, ampliando visibilidade e influência.
  • Incentivar trocas internacionais de conhecimento, quando pertinente.

Capacitação e Suporte

  • Formar e sensibilizar equipes quanto ao uso de dados, MA e gestão do conhecimento.
  • Apoiar gestores na elaboração de planos de trabalho baseados em indicadores e evidências.
  • Conduzir workshops, treinamentos e mentorias para disseminar metodologias e boas práticas.

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Economia, Sociologia, Administração, Políticas Públicas ou áreas correlatas.

Diferencial: Pós-graduação em Monitoramento e Avaliação de Projetos Sociais, Políticas Públicas ou Gestão do Conhecimento será diferencial.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Proficiência em SQL, Python, R e ferramentas de manipulação/análise de dados;
  • Experiência em Ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias qualitativas e quantitativas de pesquisa;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de coleta de dados (KoboToolbox, SurveyCTO);
  • Experiência em ferramentas colaborativas de gestão do conhecimento (SharePoint, Confluence, plataformas de intranet, IA aplicada).

Senioridade: Executive

Tipo de contratação: Full-time

Função: Administrative

  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis, CI/CD e pipelines de automação (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).

  • – Antecipar desafios, sugerir melhorias e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados.

  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade
  • – Ajustar-se rapidamente a mudanças de requisitos, novas tecnologias e prioridades de negócio.

title: Técnico de Processos Jr
description:
Overview

MAKE GOOD. NO COMPROMISE.

Líderes em biologia sintética, começamos em 2003 com uma bolsa da Fundação Bill & Melinda Gates para criar uma molécula para tratar a malária. Ao desenvolver a genética de cepas de leveduras e fermentá-las em xarope de cana-de-açúcar, fomos os pioneiros na capacidade de converter açúcares básicos de plantas em moléculas de hidrocarbonetos. Até o momento, criamos e comercializamos com sucesso um total de 13 ingredientes sustentáveis que são usados por centenas de milhões de pessoas, em produtos feitos por mais de 3.000 marcas globais importantes.

Na Amyris, nosso objetivo é grande e amplo, criando prosperidade para as pessoas, o planeta e os negócios. Para que possamos continuar a cumprir a promessa da biologia sintética e causar um impacto duradouro.

Aqui na Amyris, somos um time de pessoas criativas e inovadoras “Make Good. No Compromise”. Nós valorizamos as relações saudáveis em diferentes perspectivas e nos empenhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, abrangendo diferentes raças, etnias, gêneros, religiões, pessoas com deficiências e comunidade LGBTQIA+.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades
  • Operação de fermentadores e análises de processos de fermentação (físico-químicas) em escala Piloto.
  • Operação de UHTs, centrifugas, filtro prensa, evaporadores em escala Piloto.
  • Operação de Caldeiras e rotas de Utilidades, se necessário, em escala Piloto.
  • Calibrações e leituras diárias de equipamentos de bancada.
  • Fornecer apoio na Planta de Produção em escala Industrial durante transferências de tecnologia.
  • Limpeza e organização da área, descarte de amostras de processos, etc.
  • Atuar junto ao setor de desenvolvimento nos processos de produção de novos produtos;
  • Preparação de relatórios e apresentações para reuniões semanais e mensais com o Grupo de Tecnologia.
Requisitos
  • Formação Técnica em Química, Alimentícia, Biológica ou Produção;
  • CRQ ativo;
  • Disponibilidade de atuação em Turno;
  • Disponibilidade de atuação em Escala 5X2;
  • Diferencial experiência prévia com processos de fermentação e/ ou centrifugação;
  • Diferencial NR13 ativo.

title: Senior Data Scientist – Logistics Intelligence
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our logistics intelligence team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and scaling advanced models that support key areas such as:

  • Inventory availability forecasting by learning from replenishment patterns to improve Available-to-Promise (ATP) accuracy;
  • Last-mile logistics optimization, including routing, stop sequencing, ETA prediction, and delivery window generation;
  • Product substitution recommendation, ensuring customers receive relevant alternatives when requested items are unavailable.
You will be involved in the end-to-end model development process, from exploration and experimentation to production deployment. You will collaborate with Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers, and Analysts to implement near real-time and batch systems supporting global operations through the BEES platform.
Our team is based in New York and Brazil, and our systems serve multiple markets and business models worldwide. We seek professionals motivated to apply the latest advances in AI and machine learning to solve complex fulfillment and logistics challenges.

What you'll do:

  • Develop models to forecast inventory availability by analyzing replenishmentsignals to enhance ATP decisions.
  • Design and deploy ML solutions for route optimization, delivery sequencing, ETAestimation , and delivery window modeling .
  • Build product substitution systems using behavioral, inventory, and productsimilarity data
  • Own projects end-to-end—from problem definition and modeling to deploymentand monitoring.
  • Collaborate with engineering and analytics partners to integrate solutions into Realtime and batch pipelines .
  • Write clean, scalable, and efficient code in Python and PySpark using Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Translate research insights and academic papers into working production code.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or any quantitative field; Master’s or PhD strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success applying machine learning and statistical modeling techniques in production environments to drive measurable business impact.
  • Experience mentoring and coaching data scientists and engineers, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing within cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, Databricks, and Spark for big data processing and analysis.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Python/PySpark for data manipulation, analysis, and modeling tasks. Strong knowledge of relevant libraries and frameworks.
  • Good knowledge of CI/CD tools like Github for version control and collaboration. Familiarity with other collaboration tools is a plus.
  • Understanding of workflows and automation tools to streamline processes and enhance efficiency.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.
Team & Culture
  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.
You can be a Rock-Star if you have Core Skills & Experience
  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.
Key Qualities
  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.
Bonus Points
  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.
Living Our Values
  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.
Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check and psychometric profiling
  • Offer
How To Apply
  • Submit your CV in English, as this is the main language used at InPlanet (Portuguese accepted if justified).

Being an equal opportunity employer, InPlanet does not discriminate on grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We design our processes to be fair and equitable and believe in continuous learning.

Join Solventum, the new company born from 3M Healthcare's spin‑off. We enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a Marketing Director – Upstream, you’ll partner with leading minds in healthcare to develop innovative solutions that integrate technology, compassion, and empathy.

Job Description

The role focuses on building and leading portfolio strategy, guiding new product development, overseeing M&A evaluations, and delivering cross‑functional alignment.

The Impact You’ll Make
  • Build and lead portfolio strategy for your area, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer needs.
  • Identify organic and inorganic growth opportunities, prioritize them in alignment with strategic goals.
  • Conduct in‑depth market assessments, customer and competitive analyses to evaluate opportunities before allocating resources to new product development projects.
  • Lead evaluation of M&A targets to assess strategic, customer and business alignment.
  • Manage and develop a team of upstream product managers to execute projects, ensuring new products meet unmet customer needs and align with the portfolio strategy.
How You Will Make An Impact
  • Partner cross‑functionally with R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Finance and downstream marketing to align portfolio and NPD projects with business goals and deliver value.
  • Bring an external perspective by cultivating deep customer, market and competitive insights to guide investment decisions and portfolio priorities in connection with the business and portfolio strategy.
Your Skills and Expertise

Demonstrated success in developing and executing portfolio or business strategy, balancing resource constraints and opportunity.

  • Proven track record of successfully launching new products in the medical device segment, from concept through commercialization, with measurable business impact.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate market, customer and competitive insights into actionable strategies.
  • Cross‑functional leadership and influence skills, with experience partnering across R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Operations and Commercial teams to deliver results.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field and at least 10 years of relevant business experience, ideally in medical device, healthcare technologies or adjacent regulated industries.
  • 7+ years in marketing, product management or strategy roles with increasing scope and responsibility.
  • 5+ years of experience leading new product development initiatives in the medical device industry, taking projects from concept through launch.
  • 3+ years managing direct reports, including mentoring or developing product or upstream marketing talent.
Additional Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Life Sciences or related field.
  • Experience in global product markets (e.g., launching or marketing products in multiple geographies with cross‑border regulatory and reimbursement considerations).
  • Prior exposure to highly regulated global environments (e.g., FDA, CE).
  • Proven track record of delivering product launches on time, on budget, with measurable business impact.

  • Realizar análise de vídeos, a fim de verificar se as atividades que estão sendo executadas em campo, estão condizentes com os normativos da empresa;
  • Identificar pontos de melhorias dentro das análises de vídeos para contribuir com a melhoria dos nossos processos e normativos;

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Domain knowledge (e.g.: experience in industry, laws, HR, marketing, etc.).

Isso é possível, devido as nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL ), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE ), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Um pouco da nossa stack :

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask ) efrontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando emkubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar testes nos códigos desenvolvidos a fim de garantir sua qualidade;
  • Identificar, analisar e corrigir anomalias de alta complexidade no sistema;
  • Priorizar atividades de desenvolvimento da área com base no nível de urgência e complexidade da ação;
  • Analisar e acompanhar a evolução das metas da área;
  • Realizar reportes sob demanda para o Head da área.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo na área de exatas (tecnologia da informação, ciência da computação, engenharia, matemática e áreas afins);
  • Conhecimento em linguagem de programaçãoPython ;
  • Conhecimento para utilização doGit com ferramenta de versionamento de código;
  • Conhecimento de lógica de programação estruturada e estrutura de dados;
  • Desejável, mas não obrigatório, conhecimento em Figma, padrão RestAPI e Sql.

No papel de SENIOR EMBEDDED SOFTWARE DEVELOPER (AGRICULTURAL SYSTEMS) , você fará parte da equipe de Desenvolvimento de Software , com a missão de liderar o desenvolvimento de software embarcado para o controle e conectividade de máquinas agrícolas, garantindo soluções de ponta para o setor agropecuário.

Responsabilidades principais:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de software embarcado para o controle e conectividade de máquinas agrícolas.
  • Planejar, especificar, codificar, testar, integrar e documentar sistemas complexos.
  • Realizar validações de laboratório e de campo, analisando criticamente os resultados e preparando relatórios técnicos.
  • Coordenar tecnicamente projetos em parceria com institutos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento.

Qualificações:

Qualificações mínimas:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de sistemas embarcados com C/C++ ou Python.
  • Linux Embarcado:
    • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento e personalização de distribuições Linux para sistemas embarcados (por exemplo, Yocto, Buildroot).

    • Conhecimento aprofundado de ISOBUS (ISO 11783), incluindo estrutura de mensagem, Terminal Virtual (VT), Controlador de Tarefa (TC) e compatibilidade de implementação.
    • Experiência com J1939, especialmente em aplicações agrícolas e veículos off-road, com compreensão de PGNs, SPNs e gerenciamento de rede.
    • Habilidade para implementar e validar pilhas de comunicação CAN personalizadas, focando em confiabilidade e desempenho.
  • Experiência comprovada com Qt, MQTT e sistemas IoT.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas como GIT, Bitbucket, Jira e Confluence.

  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.

title: Smartsheet Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: Smartsheet Solution Architect

Location: Remote in LATAM (EST time zone required)

Duration: 6-12 months


Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and certified Smartsheet Solution Architect & PMO Leader to drive the strategic design, implementation, and optimization of our work management and Project Portfolio Management (PPM) solutions. This is a critical leadership role for an individual who not only understands Smartsheet at an architectural level but can also establish and mature enterprise-wide Project Management Office (PMO) standards and capabilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong eye for design and user experience, able to provide expert guidance on sheet layout, structure, and visual presentation to ensure optimal usability and engagement.Key Responsibilities


Smartsheet Architecture & Development

  • Design and Architect Solutions: Lead the end-to-end architectural design and development of complex, integrated Smartsheet solutions, including utilizing premium applications like Control Center, Resource Management, and Dynamic View, to meet Gordian's strategic business needs.
  • Platform Optimization: Act as the Smartsheet expert and Administrator , continuously optimizing the platform for performance, scalability, and user experience.
  • Governance and Standards: Establish and enforce Smartsheet governance, best practices, and standardization for dashboards, reporting, automation, and data integrity across the organization.
  • Stakeholder Mobilization: Introduce and drive adoption of the Smartsheet platform and its capabilities across all levels of company leadership.
  • Design Excellence: Provide expert consultation on the visual design and structural layout of sheets , dashboards, and reports, ensuring they are intuitive, aesthetically pleasing, and aligned with user experience best practices. Project & Program Management Office (PMO) Leadership
  • PMO Implementation: Establish, lead, and mature the PMO function —defining, documenting, and implementing project management standards, best practices, and procedures (PMP methodologies).
  • PPM Tool Implementation: Establish and lead the use of Smartsheetas the primary PPM tool for enterprise-wide intake, demand, and resource management, portfolio management, and real-time status reporting.
  • Strategic Alignment: Charter and lead executive-level bodies, such as a Steering Committee or Project Review Board (PRB), to ensure project and program portfolios are aligned with strategic goals and organizational objectives.
  • Process Improvement: Drive measurable improvements in project delivery metrics, such as increasing on-time completion rates and enhancing strategic focus through effective prioritization methods.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience

  • Progressive leadership experience in Project Management, Program Management, and/or PMO Director roles.
  • Expert-level experience in Smartsheet development, configuration, and administration, with a proven track record of implementing the platform in multiple corporate environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in establishing, leading, and maturing a corporate PMO from the ground up, including hiring and managing a team of Project Managers, Business Analysts, and Scrum Masters.
  • Experience managing multiple project portfolios (e.g., infrastructure, application development) valued over $10M each and managing over 300 concurrent projects.
  • Experience in change management and successfully integrating new processes and teams following acquisitions or mergers.
  • Design sensibility and UX expertise with the ability to evaluate and provide constructive feedback on sheet design, layout optimization, color schemes, formatting, and overall visual presentation to enhance usability and user adoption.


Certifications

  • Smartsheet Solution Architect Certified (Essential)
  • Smartsheet Certified Solution Consultant (Highly preferred)
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) (Essential)
  • Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) (Preferred)
  • Certified Agile Practitioner (PMI-ACP) (Preferred)


Education & Logistics

  • Education: Master’s degree in project management or a related field is highly desirable
  • Work Hours: This role will primarily operate on Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours to align with company operations.
  • Location: Remote

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer with extensive ITOM experience to lead the development and enhancement of our ServiceNow platform. Must be able to work in fast-paced environment, often requiring collaboration with various teams and stakeholders.

  • Design, develop, and implement complex ServiceNow ITOM solutions including CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.

  • 5-7 years of ServiceNow development experience with a focus on ITOM.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and Integrations.
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Glide API, REST/SOAP integrations, and ServiceNow scripting.
  • Experience with automation and DevOps practices, familiarity with continuous integration (CI/CD), code versioning tools such as Git, and Agile principles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status; nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity; strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere
  • Direct collaboration with an entrepreneurial leader
  • Exposure to multiple industries: Construction, lead generation, nonprofit, real estate
  • Ground-floor opportunity: Help build foundational systems for scaling ventures
  • Learning environment: Strong focus on AI implementation and automation
Company Culture & Values


Culture in one line: We are problem solvers—systems over heroics—and the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.


Core Values:

  • Integrity
  • Growth Minded
  • In Service to Others
  • Provide Solutions
Onboarding & Support


There is currently no formal onboarding program—this will be part of the early partnership. You'll collaboratively identify the tools and support structures needed to achieve great outcomes. This is an opportunity to help shape the operational foundation from the ground up.


Application Process


Please send the following to (operations+ ) :

  • Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.pdf)
  • Cover Letter addressing:
  • How you meet the required skills and experience
  • Specific examples of systems or SOPs you've built
  • Your experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, automation tools)
  • A time you anticipated a leader's needs and proactively solved a problem
  • How you've closed loops and driven projects to completion
  • Why you're interested in supporting multiple ventures simultaneously
  • AI Competency Example: Share a specific example of how you've used AI tools to automate a workflow, solve a problem, or improve efficiency
  • Email Subject: Systems Over Heroics

Timeline: We aim to fill this position within 2–3 weeks.

Well-structured and thoughtful applications demonstrating critical thinking and systems-first approach will stand out. If you have questions about the role, feel free to include them in your message.

title: SRE Analyst
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Sênior para fortalecer a base técnica que sustenta nossa plataforma de dados financeiros. Como SRE na Gorila, você será peça-chave na construção e evolução de uma infraestrutura escalável, observável e resiliente, garantindo que nossos sistemas possam crescer com segurança e agilidade — sem perder o foco em qualidade, performance e confiabilidade.


Você atuará diretamente no suporte à nossa missão: entregar clareza e controle para investidores e instituições através de dados financeiros bem tratados, acessíveis e confiáveis. Isso significa garantir que os pipelines de dados estejam sempre disponíveis, que os sistemas sejam fáceis de operar e monitorar, e que o time de engenharia possa inovar com autonomia e confiança.


No dia a dia, você será responsável por liderar iniciativas de automação, infraestrutura como código, práticas de GitOps e observabilidade, utilizando ferramentas como Kubernetes (EKS), ArgoCD, Crossplane, Istio, Grafana e Prometheus. Seu trabalho será essencial para garantir que nossa plataforma continue sendo uma referência em confiabilidade, tanto para investidores individuais quanto para grandes instituições financeiras que consomem nossos dados via integrações e APIs.


Responsabilidades

Projetar, implementar e manter a infraestrutura baseada em AWS e Kubernetes (EKS)

Criar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitHub Actions e ArgoCD

Implementar e gerenciar observabilidade com Grafana, Prometheus, Loki e Tempo

Garantir a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, incluindo controle de acesso, rede e comunicação entre serviços com Istio

Automatizar a criação e gerenciamento de recursos na AWS com Terraform, Crossplane e Kustomization


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Experiência com AWS e serviços como EKS, RDS, IAM, S3, entre outros

Conhecimento sólido em redes, protocolos de comunicação, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, TLS e roteamento

Forte conhecimento em Kubernetes e ferramentas de gerenciamento de infraestrutura

Experiência com ArgoCD e GitOps

Conhecimento avançado em observabilidade e tracing distribuído

Experiência com Istio ou outra solução de Service Mesh

Experiência com automação e infraestrutura como código (Crossplane, Kustomization, Terraform, etc.)

Conhecimento em CI/CD com GitHub Actions ou similares

Experiência em troubleshooting e otimização de PostgreSQL em produção

Conhecimento em scripting (Bash, Python ou Go) para automação

Experiência com práticas de FinOps


Diferenciais:

Experiência com security hardening em ambientes Kubernetes

Experiência com Open Policy Agent ou similares

Experiência com banco de dados PostgreSQL, garantindo alta disponibilidade e otimização de desempenho

Experiência em gerenciamento de Operadores de Bancos de Dados no Kubernetes como CloudNativePG e Zalando

title: Analista Funcional Sênior (Especialista no Setor de Energia Elétrica)
description:
Resumo da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Analista Funcional Sênior com profunda experiência no Setor de Energia Elétrica para atuar como o elo estratégico entre as unidades de negócio e as equipes de desenvolvimento de software.

O profissional será responsável por traduzir as complexas necessidades de negócio e regulatórias do setor em requisitos técnicos e funcionais claros, garantindo que as soluções de TI entreguem o máximo valor e estejam em total conformidade com as operações.


Principais Atribuições e Responsabilidades


  • Análise e Levantamento de Requisitos: Liderar sessões de discovery e entrevistas com stakeholders do setor elétrico para identificar, analisar, priorizar e documentar requisitos de negócio complexos.
  • Especificação Funcional e Técnica: Traduzir os requisitos de negócio em especificações funcionais detalhadas, Histórias de Usuário (User Stories) robustas, Casos de Uso e Critérios de Aceitação inequívocos, assegurando a conformidade com as regras de negócio e regulamentações do setor.
  • Mapeamento e Otimização de Processos: Analisar e modelar processos de negócio (utilizando notações como BPMN), identificando gargalos e propondo fluxos otimizados (As-Is e To-Be) que maximizem a eficiência operacional através da tecnologia.
  • Interface Técnica (SME): Atuar como o Subject Matter Expert (SME) funcional para as equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e QA, garantindo o alinhamento técnico da solução com a especificação funcional e resolvendo impedimentos.
  • Validação e Garantia de Qualidade: Elaborar planos de testes funcionais e de integração. Conduzir e/ou suportar ativamente os Testes de Aceitação do Usuário (UAT), validando a aderência da entrega aos requisitos de negócio.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento: Criar e manter a documentação funcional dos sistemas e colaborar na elaboração de materiais de treinamento e manuais para os usuários finais.


Requisitos Essenciais


  • Formação: Superior completa em Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia (Elétrica, de Software, Produção) ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Análise: Experiência consolidada (mínimo de 5 anos) atuando como Analista Funcional, Analista de Negócios de TI ou Product Owner (PO) em projetos de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Expertise Setorial (Mandatório): Experiência comprovada em projetos de TI para o Setor de Energia Elétrica (Geração, Transmissão ou Distribuição). Conhecimento prático em sistemas de missão crítica do setor (ex: SCADA, OMS, GIS, CIS, Faturamento ou Gestão de Ativos).
  • Metodologias: Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e práticas de engenharia de requisitos (elaboração de User Stories, BDD, etc.).
  • Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade analítica avançada para decompor problemas complexos, pensamento sistêmico e foco na solução de problemas de causa raiz.
  • Comunicação Interpessoal: Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e facilitação, capaz de atuar como tradutor eficaz entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Qualificações Desejáveis


  • Modelagem: Conhecimento avançado em notação BPMN e experiência com ferramentas de prototipação de interface (ex: Figma, Balsamiq).
  • Certificações: Certificações ativas em Análise de Negócios (ex: CBAP, PMI-PBA) ou Métodos Ágeis (ex: CSPO, PSPO).
  • Plataformas: Experiência com sistemas ERP ou plataformas específicas do setor (ex: SAP IS-U, Oracle Utilities ou similares).

title: Director, Business Value Consulting
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Remote: Sao Paulo, Brazil
Your Career
In this Director Business Value Consulting role, you will build value-based business-cases for cybersecurity investment, by leading cross-functional teams composed of customer-executives, sales team, solution consultants, and other functional groups. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.

  • Create industry-specific and Palo Alto Networks solution-based value selling tools, programs, and initiatives for sales, alliances, and marketing teams

  • Expertise in building business cases with in-depth financial analysis and ROI/TCO modeling
  • Strong executive presence and situational awareness, with a proven track record of influencing C-suite leaders to drive key business decisions
  • Proven ability to foster accountability and build consensus across teams and customers, driving operational excellence and ensuring high-quality deliverables
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, applying consulting frameworks and methodologies, while offering creative solutions to drive executive decisions
  • Ability to quickly adapt and contribute to projects across various industries, including IT and OT challenges in cybersecurity, business applications, and systems

Additional Information
The Team
Business Value Consulting is a strategic, consultative team that engages with Fortune 1000 and public sector customers to build and deliver strategic business justification as their cybersecurity partner. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.
The Worldwide Shared Services org is dedicated to empowering Palo Alto Networks’ go-to-market teams through innovative solutions and strategic guidance to drive superior outcomes. We strive to equip our teams with the expertise and resources needed to make a meaningful and lasting impact with the customers we serve while achieving sales excellence. We are committed to fostering an environment where our team members can thrive, creating a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing to drive collective growth and success.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!
